title: Barcelona defender to have an official renewal ceremony after signing contract in summer
tweet: Christensen signed a two‑year extension on 1 July, keeping him at Barça until 2028. Despite a new quadriceps setback that will sideline him for about two months, the club plans an official renewal ceremony before the sessions for Bernal and Espart. As things stand, the date is still pending.

title: Barcelona face a fresh challenge with their increasing wage bill
tweet: Barcelona’s wage bill is rising again, projected to hit €636 m this season, the same figure as 2019‑20. As things stand, the 53% share of revenue is lower than the 74% of that year, but the upward trend still demands attention as match‑day income may dip next season.

title: From Messi to Raphinha: Barcelona’s remarkable history of reinventing their best attackers
tweet: Raphinha's shift from wide to No. 9 echoes Barcelona's long history of positional reinvention. Samitier, Laudrup, Messi and Ferran all followed the same pattern, and Flick's move keeps their tactical DNA intact. As things stand, the move is less an emergency than a natural evolution of an already versatile attacker.
